unit: consented installation within one account and consent epoch; no cross-device joining

catalog.hypothesis: A clear invitation heading supports voluntary useful practice without increasing sharing pressure.
A concrete tiny-step prompt supports voluntary useful practice without increasing burden.

design.primaryMetric: effective voluntary did/didMore saved within 7 days after rendered exposure, observed at followup
design.planning: Conservative normal approximation at maximum Bernoulli variance 0.25: ceil(2*(2.241403+0.841621)^2*0.25/0.05^2)=1902 per arm; rounded up to 2000. This plans 80% power to reject zero lift at true 0.05 lift, not to prove the 0.05 practical bound. The stricter lower-confidence-bound promotion rule needs roughly 0.10 true lift for that power. Not a guarantee under clustering/missingness.
design.stopping: One fixed final analysis after enrollment+followup+late arrival; never promote at interim looks. Kill/control on errors at any time.
